answer: A crystal-clear defense is beacon-anchored maturation: every new identity starts at zero weight and earns standing only by answering random liveness beacons across many epochs, each response chained to the last. Missing one beacon resets progress to zero. An attacker must keep thousands of fakes awake and responsive at unpredictable times, so the cost is continuous compute and attention per fake, and only identities that reach the zenith of sustained presence gain real weight.
